_comment: GROUND TRUTH for the money function. All objective math derives from this file. PER-SEASON keyed by year (master sheet, 2026-08-08): the structure CHANGED across eras, so money math must pick the season's own config. `current` mirrors the active season (2026) for the money-function default + backward compat. E[$] = Sum_w P(weekly-high,w)*weekly + P(RS champ)*champ + P(RS 2nd)*runner_up + Sum_k P(finish k)*playoff[k], using THAT season's amounts.
weekly_high_scope_note: Master sheet (in writing): the weekly-$100 high is REGULAR SEASON ONLY — weeks 1-15 pay, playoff weeks do not.

2023.note: League year one — SMALLER pot. Corrects the earlier era-mismatch: Cory's 2023 THIRD paid $400, not $475.

2024.note: Playoffs 675/550/500/400 — DIFFERS from 2026. Corrects MarianSaar 2nd=$550 (not 575), cashworth 3rd=$500 (not 475).

2026.note: ACTIVE season. Playoffs changed 2nd/3rd to 575/475 vs 2024-25's 550/500.

2027.note: PLANNED reversion (playoff 2nd/3rd back to 550/500) + a $500 buy-in vote PENDING. Not final — the January rollover diff (Part 12 / Annual) catches the outcome. Do not use for grading.

regular_season.tiebreak_note: Master sheet rules tab (confirmed): RS ties break on TOTAL POINTS. Corroborated by Cory's 2024 8.2-point tiebreak miss.

weekly_high.note: 37.5% of the pot — regular season only, paid to the league-high score each week.

regular_season.note: Rewards consistent winning; the floor still buys RS money + playoff entry.

playoffs.note: Flat gradient: top-4 ENTRY (~$400 floor) is the real prize.

draft.note: Draft is UNTIMED (pick_timer=0 at source). Hard time-pressure cues dropped; the LRM countdown counts PICKS.

rules.pick_trade_note: League rule (master sheet): traded picks must swap within ONE round of each other — a hard constraint for the pick-trade valuator.
rules.pending_votes_note: Live governance on the Votes tab — 2027 config may move; the January rollover diff covers it.

_data_spine_note: The master sheet's own TOTAL column is STALE (excludes 2025 for several owners) — the exact disease the data spine cures. Career money derives from YEAR columns, never the sheet Total.
